title: Implement automatic cleanup and bounded storage retention
goal: Preview and safely apply protected-reference-aware retention for runtime work Evidence diagnostics and caches with restart-safe receipts.
acceptanceCriteria: Cleanup classifies every candidate and keep/delete reason and never evicts protected authority or referenced data.
Age count and capacity policies are deterministic and configurable with the accepted provisional defaults.
Apply accepts an exact preview hash and rechecks leases references canonical paths and links.
Deletion uses owned restart-safe tombstones and emits an exact schema-valid receipt.
Installed and ordinary State measurements are reported without turning provisional limits into compatibility promises.
risks: Unsafe deletion could remove unowned or protected data.
Concurrent runs can invalidate a preview.
Provisional limits could be treated as stable promises.
decisions: Use exact preview/apply with durable tombstones and receipts.
Age/count rules retain the smaller eligible set.
